text: The sales forecast for Pane from May 16, 2026, to June 12, 2026, projects a total of 6,219 units sold. This averages to 222 units per day, representing a 4.3 percent increase compared to the previous period average of 213 units per day. Sales are expected to peak on Saturdays with an average of 283 units and drop to their lowest on Tuesdays at 173 units. Based on 500 days of historical data, the forecasting model achieved a 21.2 percent accuracy improvement over the standard benchmark.
